hero.heading: Clarity for today. Confidence for what comes next.
hero.text: Thoughtful legal advice for businesses, individuals and the decisions that matter. We turn complex questions into a clear way forward.
hero.caption: A clearer perspective

perspective.title: Good counsel begins with understanding.
perspective.text: Legal matters rarely exist in isolation. They affect your plans, your relationships and your peace of mind. At Gamaliel Consult, we start with the bigger picture — then focus on the detail that makes a difference.

practice.title: Advice that meets you where you are.

cards.title: Corporate & commercial
cards.text: From everyday contracts to strategic transactions, clear advice for your next business decision.

cards.title: Dispute resolution
cards.text: A measured approach to protecting your position and finding a constructive resolution.

cards.title: Property & real estate
cards.text: Careful guidance through the legal detail of buying, selling, leasing and developing property.

founder.title: A steady perspective for the decisions that matter.
founder.intro: Gamaliel Consult was built on the idea that thoughtful legal counsel should be clear, practical and personal. Meet the founder behind the firm.
founder.name: Sample Founder
founder.bio: With a background in corporate, commercial and dispute work, the founder helps clients move from uncertainty to a clearer next step. His approach is built on listening carefully, explaining options plainly and advising with a long-term view.

team.title: A team designed to help you move forward with confidence.
team.intro: Practical judgment. Clear communication. A shared commitment to helping you move forward. Team profiles and portraits are illustrative.

approach.title: Less uncertainty. More direction.
approach.intro: From the first conversation to the next decision, you should know where you stand.

steps.title: Listen first
steps.text: We take time to understand your circumstances, priorities and concerns.

steps.title: Find the way forward
steps.text: We explain your options, the risks and a practical course of action.

steps.title: Move with purpose
steps.text: We agree the scope and fees, then keep you informed as your matter progresses.
